#!/usr/bin/env python3
import math
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict


def jacobi_eigenvalues(matrix):
    a = [row[:] for row in matrix]
    for _ in range(80):
        p, q = 0, 1
        largest = abs(a[0][1])
        for i in range(3):
            for j in range(i + 1, 3):
                if abs(a[i][j]) > largest:
                    largest = abs(a[i][j])
                    p, q = i, j
        if largest < 1e-12:
            break
        theta = 0.5 * math.atan2(2.0 * a[p][q], a[q][q] - a[p][p])
        c, s = math.cos(theta), math.sin(theta)
        for i in range(3):
            if i not in (p, q):
                aip, aiq = a[i][p], a[i][q]
                a[i][p] = a[p][i] = c * aip - s * aiq
                a[i][q] = a[q][i] = s * aip + c * aiq
        app, aqq, apq = a[p][p], a[q][q], a[p][q]
        a[p][p] = c * c * app - 2.0 * s * c * apq + s * s * aqq
        a[q][q] = s * s * app + 2.0 * s * c * apq + c * c * aqq
        a[p][q] = a[q][p] = 0.0
    return sorted((a[0][0], a[1][1], a[2][2]), reverse=True)


def parse(path):
    atoms = []
    ca = []
    models = set()
    active_model = 1
    element_counts = Counter()
    chain_residues = defaultdict(set)
    altloc_counts = Counter()
    record_counts = Counter()
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        for line in handle:
            record = line[:6].strip()
            if record == "MODEL":
                try:
                    active_model = int(line[10:14].strip())
                except ValueError:
                    active_model += 1
                models.add(active_model)
                continue
            if record == "ENDMDL":
                continue
            if record not in ("ATOM", "HETATM"):
                if record:
                    record_counts[record] += 1
                continue
            try:
                x = float(line[30:38])
                y = float(line[38:46])
                z = float(line[46:54])
            except (ValueError, IndexError):
                continue
            atom_name = line[12:16].strip()
            altloc = line[16:17].strip() or "blank"
            chain = line[21:22].strip() or "_"
            resid = line[22:26].strip()
            icode = line[26:27].strip()
            residue = (resid, icode)
            element = line[76:78].strip().upper() or atom_name[:1].upper()
            item = (x, y, z)
            atoms.append(item)
            if atom_name == "CA" and record == "ATOM":
                ca.append(item)
            models.add(active_model)
            chain_residues[chain].add(residue)
            element_counts[element] += 1
            altloc_counts[altloc] += 1
            record_counts[record] += 1
    return atoms, ca, models, chain_residues, element_counts, altloc_counts, record_counts


def stats(points):
    if not points:
        return None
    mean = [sum(p[i] for p in points) / len(points) for i in range(3)]
    mins = [min(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)]
    maxs = [max(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)]
    cov = [[0.0] * 3 for _ in range(3)]
    for p in points:
        d = [p[i] - mean[i] for i in range(3)]
        for i in range(3):
            for j in range(3):
                cov[i][j] += d[i] * d[j]
    denom = max(1, len(points) - 1)
    cov = [[v / denom for v in row] for row in cov]
    return mean, mins, maxs, jacobi_eigenvalues(cov)


def fmt(values):
    return " ".join(f"{v:.3f}" for v in values)


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        raise SystemExit("usage: diagnostic_pdb.py input.pdb output.txt")
    atoms, ca, models, chain_residues, elements, altlocs, records = parse(sys.argv[1])
    with open(sys.argv[2], "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
        out.write("PDB projection-analysis diagnostic\n")
        out.write(f"atom_records {len(atoms)}\n")
        out.write(f"ca_records {len(ca)}\n")
        out.write(f"models {len(models)} values={sorted(models)}\n")
        out.write(f"chains {len(chain_residues)} values={sorted(chain_residues)}\n")
        out.write("residues_by_chain " + " ".join(f"{c}:{len(r)}" for c, r in sorted(chain_residues.items())) + "\n")
        out.write("record_counts " + " ".join(f"{k}:{v}" for k, v in sorted(records.items())) + "\n")
        out.write("element_counts " + " ".join(f"{k}:{v}" for k, v in sorted(elements.items())) + "\n")
        out.write("altloc_counts " + " ".join(f"{k}:{v}" for k, v in sorted(altlocs.items())) + "\n")
        for label, points in (("all_atoms", atoms), ("ca_only", ca)):
            result = stats(points)
            if result is None:
                continue
            mean, mins, maxs, eig = result
            extents = [maxs[i] - mins[i] for i in range(3)]
            out.write(f"{label}_mean {fmt(mean)}\n")
            out.write(f"{label}_min {fmt(mins)}\n")
            out.write(f"{label}_max {fmt(maxs)}\n")
            out.write(f"{label}_axis_aligned_extents {fmt(extents)}\n")
            out.write(f"{label}_pca_variances {fmt(eig)}\n")
            out.write(f"{label}_pca_std_ratio {fmt([math.sqrt(max(0.0, eig[0] / eig[-1])), math.sqrt(max(0.0, eig[1] / eig[-1]))])}\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
